name: Amelia
summary: AI competency platform from The Airline Pilot Club used for pilot recruitment, assessment and training, linking flight schools and airlines.
paragraphs: AI competency platform from The Airline Pilot Club used for pilot recruitment, assessment and training, linking flight schools and airlines.
whyItMatters: Built around competency-based training standards, so airlines can screen and track pilot candidates against the same competencies they train to.
